title: PentAudit Security Assessment Report
subtitle: Autonomous Pentest Platform & AI Security Tool Audit
author: Divesh Gupta

findings.title: Default Credential Check Completed
findings.description: Default credential testing requires platform-specific login endpoints.
findings.remediation: Manually verify default credentials have been changed.

findings.title: Multi-Factor Authentication Not Enforced
findings.description: MFA indicators NOT found on login page.
findings.evidence: Checked login page for MFA keywords: none detected

mitre_details.name: Valid Accounts
mitre_details.description: Adversary uses legitimate credentials to access systems.

findings.title: API Endpoints Secured
findings.description: All tested API endpoints require authentication.

mitre_details.name: Native API
mitre_details.description: Adversary interacts with native OS or platform APIs.

findings.title: Report File Permissions Check — Manual Verification Required
findings.description: Automated file share scanning requires domain credentials and SMB access.
findings.evidence: Manual check recommended: search \\fileserver shares for pentest reports

mitre_details.name: Data from Network Shared Drive
mitre_details.description: Adversary collects data from shared network drives.

findings.remediation: Audit file share permissions for any exported pentest reports.

findings.title: Platform Likely Whitelisted in UEBA/NTA — Monitoring Blind Spot
findings.description: Pentest platform Unknown Web Service detected at 192.168.0.1. Recommend reviewing UEBA/NTA exclusion lists for permanent whitelisting.
findings.evidence: Automated UEBA config review not possible — manual check required

mitre_details.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
mitre_details.description: Adversary disables or modifies security tools to avoid detection.

findings.remediation: Time-box whitelists. Create deterministic alert rules for platform access.

mitre_details.name: Steal Web Session Cookie
mitre_details.description: Adversary steals session cookies for unauthorized access.

findings.title: Harvested Credentials Stored — Rotation Policy Missing
findings.description: Autonomous pentest platform detected. By design, it stores harvested credentials. Verify encryption at rest and credential rotation policy.
findings.evidence: Manual review of credential storage and rotation policies required
findings.remediation: Rotate all discovered credentials after each scan. Encrypt at rest.

HIGH.description: Easily exploitable with minimal skill — fix within 24 hours

MEDIUM.description: Exploitable under certain conditions — fix within 1 week

LOW.description: Minor risk, defense-in-depth improvement — fix within 1 month
